subject: Claude API integration for Notion AI — need enterprise contract by Q2
body:
Hi Anthropic team,

I'm the CTO at Notion. We're currently using OpenAI's API for our Notion AI features, but we've been benchmarking Claude Sonnet and Haiku for the past 6 weeks and the quality delta is significant — especially on long-context summarization.

We're looking to migrate our AI pipeline to Claude by end of Q2. This would cover:
- AI writing assistant (all Notion users, ~100M+ monthly)
- Q&A over workspace content
- Autofill for databases

We need an enterprise API agreement with committed throughput guarantees. Our current monthly token volume is in the range of 50B tokens/month. Happy to share exact numbers on a call.

Can we schedule a technical deep-dive this week? Our CEO Ivan Zhao would join.

Best,
Fuzzy Khosrowshahi
CTO, Notion

subject: Evaluating Claude for internal ops + potential product features
body:
Hi,

I lead the Engineering team at Webflow (~1,000 employees). We're exploring two tracks:

1. Internal: our support team handles 3,000+ tickets/week. We want to use Claude to auto-draft responses, classify tickets, and surface knowledge base gaps.

2. Product: our design team is prototyping an AI assistant inside the Webflow editor that could generate CSS, suggest layouts, and explain code — Claude's code generation quality caught our attention.

We're comparing Claude, GPT-4o, and Gemini. Our evaluation committee meets March 20th.

Could you send over enterprise pricing and a technical capabilities deck?

Thanks,
Arquay Harris
VP Engineering, Webflow

subject: Claude API for real-time video analytics — procurement timeline Q2
body:

subject: AI-powered HR compliance + internal productivity tools
body:
Hello,

I'm a Product Manager at Gusto working on our AI initiatives. We serve 300K+ small businesses and are thinking about Claude in two ways:

Product side: We want to build an AI compliance advisor that helps our customers navigate employment law across all 50 states. This needs to be extremely accurate and cite sources — we think Claude's approach to safety and accuracy fits well.

Internal side: Our 2,500-person team spends significant time on manual document review, internal knowledge lookups, and drafting customer communications.

We're early in the evaluation but our CPO is supportive. No formal timeline yet. Can you share case studies from companies doing similar things?

Sarah Kim
Product Manager, Gusto

subject: Re: AI features roadmap — Claude vs GPT comparison results
body:
Hi,

Following up from our meeting at the AI Engineering Summit. We ran a head-to-head evaluation of Claude Sonnet vs GPT-4o for our AI formula generation and data classification features.

Results: Claude won on structured output accuracy (94% vs 87%) and was 40% cheaper on our benchmark workload. GPT-4o was slightly faster on simple tasks.

We're ready to move forward with a pilot on Claude. 1,000 beta users initially, expanding to all 500K+ Airtable customers if the pilot succeeds.

Key question: can you support our volume tier with guaranteed latency SLAs? We need p95 < 2s for interactive features.

David Azose
CTO, Airtable

subject: Exploring Claude for equity document analysis
body:

subject: Claude for Figma AI — replacing our current LLM provider
body:

subject: AI vendor evaluation -- board presentation Thursday
body:
Hi team,

I'm Jason Boehmig, Co-founder and Executive Chairman at Ironclad. We're the leading contract lifecycle management platform -- $200M ARR, named a Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader three years running, serving enterprise customers including Salesforce, L'Oreal, Mastercard, and OpenAI.

I'm reaching out because we're at a critical inflection point with our AI strategy. Our AI Assist product and our newer Jurist legal assistant are currently built on GPT-4, and we're experiencing accuracy issues that are creating real risk. Our General Counsel Jasmine Singh flagged three contract analysis errors last month that could have exposed our enterprise customers to liability -- that's unacceptable when you're processing legal documents for companies like Mastercard and Cisco.

We just hired a new VP of AI (Mingsheng Hong) and CPO (Herman Man) specifically to scale our AI contracting capabilities. Our engineering team is already evaluating multi-model architectures -- our job postings explicitly reference Claude alongside other LLM providers. We need a model that handles legal nuance, complex reasoning, and delivers enterprise-grade reliability.

Here's what we need:
1. Claude API for our contract review and redlining product -- replacing GPT-4 where accuracy matters most
2. Claude Enterprise with SSO for our 793 employees doing legal research, drafting, and analysis
3. A partner who understands legal tech -- we're not just buying an API, we're building the future of AI contracting

We have $300-500K in budget allocated and I'm presenting vendor recommendations to our board (which includes partners from Accel, Sequoia, and Franklin Templeton) next Thursday. Our $3.2B valuation and $333M in funding means we move fast when we find the right partner.

Can someone senior get on a call with me and our new VP of AI this week?

Jason Boehmig
Executive Chairman & Co-founder, Ironclad

subject: Claude for expense intelligence + internal automation
body:

Karim

subject: Claude API for automated background check analysis
body:
Hi Anthropic,

Daniel Yanisse, CTO at Checkr. We run 20M+ background checks annually for companies like Uber, Instacart, and DoorDash.

We want to use Claude to:
- Extract and normalize data from court records and public databases
- Classify adjudication outcomes with high accuracy
- Generate candidate-friendly explanations of results
- Reduce manual review by our compliance team (currently 40% of checks need human review)

This is a regulated space — FCRA compliance is non-negotiable. We need to understand Claude's approach to hallucination prevention and how you handle sensitive PII.

Budget is approved, we're choosing between Claude and a fine-tuned open-source approach. Timeline: decision by April 1.

Daniel Yanisse
CTO, Checkr
